fields.System.Title: INT-304 — Projection rebuild jobs
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer during an incident, I want every projection regenerable from source, so
that drift is a ten-minute fix rather than an investigation.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given any projection in the system, then a rebuild job exists for it.
  • - Given a rebuild on correct data, then every row is unchanged — proving the incremental
  • update and the rebuild agree.
  • - Given a rebuild, then it can be scoped rather than always running over everything.
  • - Given a rebuild running during operations, then it does not block transactional work.
  • - Given a rebuild, then it reports how many rows it changed.
  • - Given a new projection story, then its rebuild job ships in the same iteration — not
  • as a follow-up.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | all projections |
| Risks | No rebuild job during an incident ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)); rebuild disagreeing with incremental update ([doc 08 §5.2](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration (rebuild-vs-incremental agreement, per projection) |
